crime_clean = crime_df.dropna(subset=['Crime_value']).reset_index(drop=True)

adj_clean = adj_df[
    (adj_df['borough'] != missing_borough) & 
    (adj_df['neighbor'] != missing_borough)
].copy()

# 3. Construct binary spatial weights matrix (symmetric, no self-weights)
boroughs = crime_clean['borough'].tolist()
n = len(boroughs)
borough_to_idx = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(boroughs)}

W = np.zeros((n, n), dtype=float)
for _, row in adj_clean.iterrows():
    b = row['borough']
    neigh = row['neighbor']
    if b in borough_to_idx and neigh in borough_to_idx and b != neigh:
        i = borough_to_idx[b]
        j = borough_to_idx[neigh]
        W[i, j] = 1.0
        W[j, i] = 1.0

# 4. Row-standardize
row_sums = W.sum(axis=1)
row_sums[row_sums == 0] = 1.0  # guard against isolated units
W = W / row_sums[:, np.newaxis]

# 5. Standardize crime rates to z-scores

z = (x - x.mean()) / np.std(x, ddof=0)

# 6. Spatial lag

quad[(z < 0) & (lag < 0)] = 'LL'
quad[(z > 0) & (lag < 0)] = 'HL'
